d:
Indian pop Icon Daler Mehndi has come with yet another peppy song ‘Ragda’ on the occasion of Holi under the production DRecords. The song is naughty and a fusion of Bhojpuri and Punjabi language. He says he wanted to sing a song in his mother tongue Bihari bhojpuri and give it a punjabi tadka. The lyrics are as vibrant as Holi colours. The music is very catchy and with Holi being around the corner, this song is surely going to hit the charts.
Daler Mehndi’s songs have always been popular and bring joy.
